svg.title: Measured against predicted epoch failure probability
svg.desc: Each point is one experiment configuration. Horizontal position is the probability predicted by the closed-form coverage law, vertical position the fraction of sampled topologies that actually failed. Each bar is the range of true rates consistent with that count, and the shaded band is the scatter a 4 000-draw sample is expected to show. Points lie along the diagonal across the whole range.
svg.text: pbad predicted by the coverage law
log scale, each gridline ×10; left: almost never fails · right: fails most epochs
bar = the range consistent with that count
grey line = law matched measurement exactly · band = scatter expected of a 4 000-draw sample
